updates.sourceText: 1 Floor Board Circuit specific - Drag Range Front floor board elements optimisation, single vertical element Seen as a package, the primary aim of these modifications has been to adapt to Monza circuit peculiar characteristics and car aerodynamic efficiency requirements.
